read_file: Read file contents from the current workspace. Prefer this before editing or summarizing repository files.
write_file: Write full file contents inside the current workspace, creating parent folders if needed. Use for whole-file creation or replacement.
edit_file: Replace the first exact text match in a workspace file. Prefer this for small localized edits over rewriting the full file.
compress: Compress conversation history to free up context window while preserving continuity.
task: Spawn an isolated subagent for exploration or bounded work and return a summary to the main agent.
load_skill: Load the full content of a named skill only when the current task needs that guidance.
search_lazy_mcp_tools: Search hidden lazy MCP tools by capability keyword before exposing any of them to the model.
activate_lazy_mcp_tools: Expose a small selected subset of lazy MCP tools for the next reasoning round.
TodoWrite: Update the in-session todo checklist. Keep it concise, with at most one item in_progress.
background_run: Run a shell command in the background and get back a task ID immediately for later polling.
spawn_teammate: Spawn an autonomous teammate thread for a clearly bounded task and role.
task_create: Create a new task on the shared task board for multi-step or multi-owner work.
worktree_create: Create a git worktree, optionally bind it to a task, and isolate changes safely.
